releases.title: Search, measuring and tab fixes
items: Closing the Search pane now takes a result's highlight off the page.
Search highlights sit on the right words on cropped pages and on pages whose boxes don't start at the corner.
Choosing another tool or tab drops a half-drawn polyline, polygon, cloud, perimeter or area, as Esc does, with its live value and snap marker.
After pages are deleted, rotated, moved or cropped, Advanced Search asks you to search again instead of saying there are no results.
The Find bar starts afresh on another tab, keeps its own words when you open an Advanced Search result, and closing one file no longer stops a search of all open files.
A bookmark whose page was deleted now says so, and opening a file that is already open under another name tells you which tab it is.

releases.title: Better tabs, more fonts and picking up where you left off
items: Pick up where you left off: in File › Settings › Start-up, choose to reopen the files that were open last time, in the same tabs with the same one selected.
Each file opens again at the page, zoom, layout and rotation you left it at.
Document tabs are easier to tell apart: the selected tab stands out, resting on a tab shows the file's details, and + opens more files.
Drag tabs to reorder them, and right-click a tab for Close Others, Close Tabs to the Right, Reopen Closed Tab, Sort by Name, Copy File Name, Rename File and more.
Text recognised with OCR can be selected and copied straight away, without reopening the file.
The Properties pane can be resized like the left pane, and the arrows on the pane edges hide or show either pane.
Comments can be selected and moved with Hand and Select Text too, and right-clicking a comment always opens its menu.
Text boxes, typewriter text and callouts can use a library of fonts that ships with the app and works offline.
Right-click selected text to copy, highlight, underline, strike out, mark it for redaction or search for it.
View › Zoom to Area: drag a rectangle and it fills the window (or hold Z while using Hand).
Right-click a picture on the page to copy it or save it as a PNG.

Images to PDF: open or drop JPG and PNG files, such as site photos or scans, to make a PDF with one image per page (each page fits its image, or A4 or Letter). Organize › Insert from Image adds images as pages to an open document.
Organize › Split Document saves parts of a document as separate PDFs: every few pages, by page ranges, or one file per top-level bookmark, into a folder you choose.

Organize › Crop Pages cuts margins off pages (typed in mm or inches, or drawn with the Crop Tool), for all pages or a range. Only the crop box changes, so Remove Crop shows the whole page again and measurements keep their values.

releases.title: A fresher look, Tell me and blank PDFs
items: A fresher look in light and dark: cool slate greys, a brighter blue and one interface font, Inter, on every computer. Every colour still meets WCAG AA contrast, and pages, highlights and sticky notes keep their colours.
Pick an accent colour (Blue, Teal, Indigo or Graphite) and a density (Comfortable or Compact) in File › Settings › Appearance. Compact is also on the View tab.
More room for the document: the product name, Quick Access, File, the tabs and the top-bar buttons now share one row.
A calmer ribbon: rounded tabs with a sliding marker, softer pressed and disabled buttons, and coloured icons for key tools such as Highlight, Sign Document, OCR and Mark for Redaction.
Check boxes, radio buttons, text boxes and lists look the same in every dialog and pane, and text areas show all their lines.
A new start screen: drop or open a PDF on the card, use a quick action, or reopen a recent file. The empty tab strip is hidden until a file is open.
Create a blank PDF from File › New, the start screen or Ctrl+Alt+N: choose the page size, orientation and number of pages.
Tell me (Alt+Q, or the lightbulb at the top right) finds any command by name. Press Enter to search, then Enter again to run it.
Tidier panes, File menu, dialogs and status bar. Long dialogs keep their buttons in view.

Pages and thumbnails show a soft placeholder while they load, and menus, dialogs and panes open with short, calm animations (none when your system asks for reduced motion). Thumbnails now appear for drawings with a very heavy first page.

File › About shows the version and build, Copy version info for bug reports, the components Triya PDF is built with and every open-source license, and this list of what's new. Third-party notices open correctly again.

releases.title: Help in its own window
items: Help opens in its own window, with step-by-step instructions and screenshots of the real app.
F1 opens Help at the topic for what you are doing, and the main dialogs have a ? button.
Search Help with Enter, print a topic, or print every topic as a manual.
Help works offline and follows the light or dark theme.

releases.title: Comment export keeps everything
items: Exporting comments to JSON keeps every comment exactly, including stamps, attached files and sticky-note pop-ups.
Importing that file brings every comment back as it was, in one undo step. Older JSON files still import.

releases.title: Dark theme and easier text comments
items: A dark theme: the moon button at the top right, Ctrl+Shift+D, or File › Settings.
Move a text box or callout by dragging it, and draw a callout in one drag.
Text boxes and callouts grow as you type, and you can style the selected text.
Drag a rectangle on the page to select every comment it touches; Shift+click adds or removes one.
Sticky notes open as pop-ups you can move, resize and reply in.
Paste a screenshot onto the page with Ctrl+V.

releases.title: Forms, bookmarks, signatures and a new ribbon
items: The ribbon adapts to the window: full labels, then icons only, then group menus.
Right-click menus, a style palette for each comment tool, and comments as cards in the Comments pane.
Edit bookmarks, make forms with the new Form tab, and add a password to a copy of a document.
Sign Document places a signature you draw, type or pick from a picture.
Attach File, Flatten Comments and Snapshot.
